preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 10^6.
The number of queries n is between 1 and 10^5.
The total length of all query strings xi is less than or equal to 10^6.
String s consists only of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for xi in queries for c in xi)
preconditions.description: Each query string xi consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output integers matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in output)
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - len(xi) + 1) if is_cyclical_isomorphic(s[i:i+len(xi)], xi)) for count, xi in zip(output, queries))
postconditions.description: For each query xi, the output count is the number of consecutive substrings of s that are cyclical isomorphic to xi.
